instruction:
Using CPSC recall 10000, report RecallID, RecallNumber, RecallDate, and Title; each product Name and NumberOfUnits; every Injuries Name and Retailers Name; every ManufacturerCountries Country; and every Hazards Name, Remedies Name, and RemedyOptions Option.

Stopping condition: Stop after every requested identifier, product, injury, retailer, manufacturing-country, hazard, remedy, and remedy-option field has been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the recall object returned by the supplied CPSC endpoint.
- Read values from their explicitly named arrays and do not substitute the longer Description or ConsumerContact fields.
- Preserve dates, quantities, punctuation, and wording exactly as returned.
- Report every entry if any requested array contains more than one object.
